title: Transport
description: Departure or arrival of a shipment. Departure and arrival are two entries, usually issued by two different parties - the agreement between both statements is part of the evidence.

consignment.description: Identifier of the consignment, e.g. container or waybill number.

conditions.description: Carriage conditions promised, where the device is temperature-sensitive (e.g. a biologic-coated implant). Whether they were kept is what measurement entries say - not this field.
